Title: Hybrid Search With RRF
Content: MemorySmith.App now has a hybrid search path for project-wiki records. The hybrid path uses Lucene.NET StandardAnalyzer tokenization for lexical ranking, reuses the local semantic scoring baseline as the semantic/vector-side signal, and fuses both ranked lists with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). This is exposed through POST /api/memories/search/hybrid, the memorysmith_hybrid_search MCP tool, and the /memories Hybrid mode. The current semantic side is still local token/tag/title/reference/alias scoring rather than embeddings; a future vector index can replace that signal without changing the hybrid API shape.
